shortDescription.text: Quantum-vulnerable Pedersen commitment: threshold signing and MPC protocols (8 file(s))

fullDescription.text: 11 reference(s) to Pedersen commitment across 8 file(s), e.g. packages/mpt-crypto/src/index.ts:34. Role, judged from paths, function names and nearby code: threshold signing and MPC protocols. Paillier, Pedersen commitments and the discrete-logarithm proofs inside threshold ECDSA and EdDSA protocols all fall to Shor's algorithm; a post-quantum threshold scheme is a protocol change, not a parameter change. Track post-quantum threshold signatures (NIST IR 8214C) and keep the protocol layer ready to swap the signature scheme; record which keys and shares must stay valid for how long. This is a forward-looking risk that depends on the arrival of a cryptographically relevant quantum computer (CRQC). No such computer is publicly known to exist today; the timeline is uncertain. It is not a present-day exploitable vulnerability. Heuristic pattern match on source text without data-flow analysis. The usage context (security-relevant or not) must be confirmed manually; treat as preliminary.
